title: Wingman
description: Wingman day1/day2: what people did (MRs, workflow runs, rollouts), the API, the external systems and GitLab. Metrics: docs/ops/metrics.md; alerts: docs/ops/runbook.md.

panels.title: Targets up
panels.description: Scraped and answering, per service. 0 is WingmanServiceDown: check the pods, then that the ServiceMonitor selects the Service (runbook).

panels.title: Running builds
panels.description: Which build each component runs (day1, day2), one row per version. Two versions for an hour fire WingmanVersionSkew: finish or roll back the rollout.

panels.title: Token rejected
panels.description: GitLab calls refused for Wingman's own token in the last 10m. Any value above 0 is WingmanGitLabTokenRejected: every user is affected; renew GITLAB_TOKEN or its membership.

panels.title: Ambiguous writes
panels.description: GitLab writes sent whose result is unknown, in the last 30m (WingmanAmbiguousWrite). Never retried: check whether the commit or merge landed before trying again (runbook).

panels.title: MRs opened
panels.description: Merge requests Wingman opened in GitLab over the dashboard's range (day1, day2 and flavor rollouts). 0 in a working day can mean nobody used Wingman, or that writes fail: see External systems.

panels.title: MRs merged
panels.description: Merge requests Wingman merged over the dashboard's range. Far fewer than opened means MRs wait for review or fail to merge (GitLab row, write safety).

panels.title: Approvals
panels.description: Merge-request approvals given through Wingman over the dashboard's range.

panels.title: Workflow runs
panels.description: Workflow starts the orchestrator accepted over the range (uninstall, provision, upgrade, add servers; one add-servers request counts once). Refused starts are in External systems. The first call of a kind after a restart may not count.

panels.title: Systems failing
panels.description: External systems with unavailable or error calls in the last 10m, with their count. None is good. Otherwise the system is down or unreachable from Wingman: see External systems for the operation, and the runbook.

panels.title: Merge requests per hour
panels.description: Merge requests Wingman opened, approved, merged and closed in GitLab, per bar (an hour, longer on long ranges); the legend sums the range. Closed includes rollouts superseding an older MR.

panels.title: Workflow starts per hour
panels.description: Workflow runs the orchestrator accepted, by kind, per bar. A start that should have happened and is missing here: look at the workflows outcomes in External systems.

panels.title: Flavor rollout runs per hour
panels.description: Flavor rollout runs (day1, ADR-0044), by what started them. Many read runs mean rollouts with work left over that people keep looking at.

panels.title: Rollout merge requests per hour
panels.description: What rollouts did with each cluster's MR. failed: GitLab refused the write; unconfirmed: the next run checks it; not_sent: GitLab stopped answering. Rising failures: GitLab row.

panels.title: MCE placement decisions per hour
panels.description: Creates checked against MCE placement (ADR-0050). Rising override: admins disagree with the pick; rising refused: forms pick MCEs that fail a check. No data until the first create.

panels.title: Requests per second by route
panels.description: Load on each route. A route far above its usual rate: a client polling hard.

panels.title: Server error ratio
panels.description: Share of requests answered 5xx, over 10m as the alert reads it. Above 5% for 10m fires WingmanHighServerErrorRate: see the 5xx table below for the route, then the logs.

panels.title: p95 request time by route
panels.description: 95th percentile time to answer, by route (status streams are long by design). A route slow for long: check its dependency's p95 in External systems.

panels.title: Responses by status class
panels.description: Answers by status class. 4xx is mostly users and expired sessions; a 5xx band is Wingman or a dependency failing.

panels.title: Slowest routes (p95 over the range)
panels.description: The 10 routes with the highest 95th percentile over the dashboard's range, status streams left out. Above 2.5s: users wait; check the route's GitLab or other calls.

targets.expr: round(sum by (route) (increase(wingman_http_requests_total{job=~"$job",route!~".*/stream"}[$__range]))) and on (route) topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (route, le) (rate(wingman_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job",route!~".*/stream"}[$__range]))) > 0)

panels.title: Routes answering 5xx (over the range)
panels.description: Routes that answered with a server error over the dashboard's range, and the share of their requests. Empty is good. Otherwise read the service's log for the route.

targets.expr: sum by (method, route) (increase(wingman_http_requests_total{job=~"$job",status_class="5xx"}[$__range])) / sum by (method, route) (increase(wingman_http_requests_total{job=~"$job"}[$__range])) > 0

panels.title: Calls per second by system
panels.description: Wingman's calls to each external system (the dependency variable filters). No calls is not an outage: an idle Wingman makes few.

panels.title: Calls by outcome
panels.description: How calls ended, stacked. not_found and conflict are answers; denied is Wingman's token refused; unavailable and error the system failing; ambiguous a write with an unknown result (docs/ops/metrics.md).

panels.title: p95 call time by system
panels.description: 95th percentile time of a call, retries included. A slow system makes every page that reads it slow; GitLab above 5s for 15m fires WingmanGitLabSlow.

panels.title: Unavailable + error ratio by system
panels.description: Share of each system's calls that failed (unavailable or error). Above 5% the system is flaky; above 20% it is down for Wingman: check it, its address and the network.

panels.title: Systems in the last 15m
panels.description: Each system's calls, the share that ended ok, the share that failed, and the p95, over the last 15m. A low ok share with no failures is answers like not_found or conflict; a failure share above 5% needs a look. Only systems Wingman called in those 15 minutes are listed.

panels.title: Calls per second by operation
panels.description: GitLab calls by GitLabPort method. A read jumping without more users: a cache not holding (ADR-0035).

panels.title: Calls by outcome
panels.description: denied: Wingman's token; unavailable: GitLab unreachable; ambiguous: a write's outcome is unknown. Any of the three for long: the runbook's section for it.

panels.title: p95 call time by operation
panels.description: 95th percentile time of each GitLab call. Above 5s for 15m fires WingmanGitLabSlow: GitLab is loaded, or the archive reads are large.

panels.title: Unavailable ratio
panels.description: Share of GitLab calls that found it unreachable or 5xx after retries, over 10m as the alert reads it. Above 20% for 10m fires WingmanGitLabUnavailable.

panels.title: Write safety per 15 minutes
panels.description: GitLab calls refused for safety, by operation and outcome, per bar. conflict: the file moved since it was read (the user re-opens it); not_mergeable: the MR cannot merge as reviewed; ambiguous: check before retrying; denied: Wingman's token or membership.
